author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m using my grinder and a diamond blade to cut this porcelain tile floor. Montolit’s STL diamond cup wheel is great for making notches in porcelain or ceramic tiles. I groove the tile on the first pass then make successive cuts to reduce chipping
